text: dsh-imagegen 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的图像生成插件，通过注册 generate_image 工具让 agent 根据文字描述调用图像模型。它内置 Doubao Seedream 和 Qwen，也支持配置 OpenAI 兼容接口及本地部署；可指定模型或别名、画面比例、生成数量和随机种子，提供参考图进行图生图，并可要求图中文字逐行照录。生成图片会保存到配置目录，并可附加到会话中显示。适合需要在 DSH 对话中制作海报、插图或基于参考图改绘的用户。使用内置远程提供方时需配置对应服务的 API key；也可连接无需密钥的本地服务。

dsh-imagegen adds a generate_image tool to DSH Web. It creates images from prompts with Doubao, Qwen, custom compatible services, or local endpoints. Calls can use reference images, select a model and aspect ratio, request several candidates, and save or attach results to the conversation.
想根据一段文字描述直接生成一张海报。
能不能把参考图片交给 DSH，再按我的要求改画？
我需要在图里准确放入指定的中文文案。
让 DSH 一次生成几张构图方案，方便我挑选。
我想把图片生成请求切换到自己配置的模型服务。
生成好的图片可以直接出现在聊天里吗？
Can I create an illustration from a prompt in my DSH conversation?
I want to edit an existing picture with instructions and use it as a visual reference.
dsh-imagegen 的功能「文字生成图片」：通过 generate_image 提交画面描述、风格与配色，调用选定图像通道生成图片，并将文件保存到输出目录。
dsh-imagegen 的功能「参考图改绘」：调用时传入 HTTP(S) 图片地址、本地绝对路径或图片 data URI，并描述希望修改的内容，即可将参考图用于生成请求。
dsh-imagegen 的功能「会话内展示」：图片完成后保存到磁盘；启用附件配置且 DSH 提供附件服务时，图片也会附加到会话并返回可显示的图片内容。
dsh-imagegen 的功能「选择模型提供方」：可选内置 Doubao 或 Qwen，也能通过 customProviders 配置兼容图像生成接口，并为调用指定模型或已配置别名。
dsh-imagegen 会将提示词和可选参考图发送给所选图像服务；输出图片写入配置目录，默认位于 DSH 启动目录下的 generated-images。
使用 Doubao 或 Qwen 远程通道需在插件设置中提供对应凭据；自定义通道可设置 API key，也支持配置为免密端点。

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · dsh-imagegen：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Registers the `generate_image` tool so the agent can create images and show them inline in the conversation.

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Features：- **Inline images** — generated images are attached to the conversation and render directly in chat (plus a same-origin `/imagegen/<file>` link as a fallback).
- **User-configurable model** — every channel's model id is yours to fill in, in Settings. Aliases and per-call overrides included.
- **Open provider table** — built-in Doubao Seedream and Aliyun qwen, plus any OpenAI-compatible `/images/generations` endpoint: gateways, relays, or local deployments (Ollama / vLLM / SD-WebUI / ComfyUI).
- **Watermark-free** — `watermark: false` is sent by default; the switch exists for the models that reject the field.
- **Verbatim in-image text** — text you supply is embedded character by character, never reworded.
- **Image-to-image** — pass a reference image (URL, absolute local path, or data URI) and describe the change.
- **Saved to disk** — every image is written to `outDir` before it is returned.
- **Several candidates in one call** — channels that declare `supportsN` produce multiple images from a single request.
- **Partial failures survive** — if some of the requested images fail, the successful ones are kept and the failures are liste

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Desktop：Launch Desktop once so it creates its profile, then **fully quit the application** before running the command.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @little-traincar/dsh-imagegen
```

Reopen Desktop to load it.

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Web：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @little-traincar/dsh-imagegen
```

Restart the web profile to load it.

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · From a local checkout or tarball：```powershell

dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./little-traincar-dsh-imagegen-0.3.1.tgz
```

text: @little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Configuration：Open **Settings → imagegen**, fill in an API key for the channel you want to use, then save. Settings are written to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and take effect on the next generation call — no restart.

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Built-in providers：| Channel | Default model | API key |
|---|---|---|
| `doubao` | `doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628` | Volcengine Ark console, or env `ARK_API_KEY` |
| `qwen` | `qwen-image-3.0-pro` | Alibaba Bailian / DashScope console, or env `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` |
| your own | you choose | see Custom providers |

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Custom providers：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | required | bare host gets `/v1/images/generations`; a `/v1` suffix gets `/images/generations` |
| `model` | required | fallback model id for this channel |
| `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` | empty | inline key, or read from the named environment variable; only a custom channel **without** `apiKeyOptional` falls back to `IMAGE_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| `apiKeyOptional` | false | keyless endpoints (local deployments) must opt in; once set, no global env fallback happens and no auth header is sent to that endpoint |
| `authHeader` / `authScheme` | `authorization` / `Bearer ` | auth header name and prefix |
| `size` / `sizes` | 1024x1024 tier | fixed size, or a per-aspect table |
| `sizeSeparator` | `x` | `*` for Alibaba-style sizes |
| `supportsN` / `maxN` | false / 4 | several images in one request |
| `sendWatermark` | true | set false for models that reject `watermark` |
| `sendN` / `sendSeed` / `sendNegativePrompt` | true | turn off parameters a model rejects |
| `sendPromptExtend` | false | true sends `prompt_extend:false` |
| `imageField` | `image` | reference-image fi

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Models：The default model may also be written as `<channel>/default` (equivalent to `<channel>`). `<channel>/model` and `<channel>/label` are historical keys written by the 0.3.1 settings card: they are still read, and saving the settings card migrates them to `<channel>`; built-in channels no longer expose those suffixes as aliases.

Any other `model` value is passed through verbatim as a model id. The result reports the `provider` and `model` actually used.

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Usage：Ask for an image in the conversation — for example: “Draw a summer coffee-shop poster: retro magazine collage, cream yellow and coffee brown, portrait; headline ‘Summer Ice Cafe Festival’, subtitle ‘Half price for the second cup’.”

The agent calls `generate_image` and the images appear inline. Every image is also written to `outDir` (default: `generated-images` under the directory dsh was started in).

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Desktop：Fully quit the application first, then:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @little-traincar/dsh-imagegen
```

@little-traincar/dsh-imagegen README · Web：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @little-traincar/dsh-imagegen
```

The command removes the bundle from the profile and uninstalls the package; restart the profile to finish unloading it. Generated images under `outDir` and the `imagegen` section of the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` are left in place — delete them yourself if you want a clean sweep.
